claims.quote: Living as we do in the closing year of the twentieth century, enjoying the blessings of a social order at once so simple and logical that it seems but the triumph of common sense
claims.description: Imagines that by the year 2000 society has been reorganized into a simple, rational, cooperative social order replacing the competitive capitalist system.

claims.quote: the present organization of society is, in its completeness, less than a century old
claims.description: Predicts a complete transformation of industrial society occurring within about a hundred years of 1887.

claims.quote: it was the general belief that the ancient industrial system, with all its shocking social consequences, was destined to last, with possibly a little patching, to the end of time.
claims.description: Imagines that the capitalist industrial system will be wholly replaced rather than lasting indefinitely.
claims.stated_time: by the end of the nineteenth/early twentieth century

claims.quote: He \[Dr. Leete\] showed how, by turning a screw, the volume of the music could be made to fill the room, or die away to an echo so faint and far that one could scarcely be sure whether he heard or imagined it.
claims.description: Music broadcast over telephone wires into homes from central concert halls, with adjustable volume (a forerunner of broadcasting).

claims.quote: A critic of the *Boston Transcript* said, when the novel first appeared, that the new State imagined by […] was all very well, but that the author lost much of his effectiveness by putting his Utopia a scant fifty years ahead
claims.description: A nationalized, egalitarian state emerging within about fifty years of 1887, i.e. by around 1937.

claims.quote: The cardinal features of '[…],' that distinguish it from the generality of Utopian literature, lie in its definite scheme of industrial organization on a national basis, and the equal share allotted to all persons in the products of industry
claims.description: A single nationally organized industrial system in which all citizens receive an equal share of the national product.

claims.quote: Much which is now established in Soviet Russia bears at least a likeness to the industrial army visioned in this prophetic book.
claims.description: An 'industrial army' in which all citizens serve in organized national labor.

claims.quote: He sees the change coming through a general recognition of the failings of the capitalist system.
claims.description: A non-violent, peaceful transition from capitalism to a cooperative commonwealth through general recognition of capitalism's failings.

claims.quote: Nowadays, as life advances toward its close, instead of being shadowed by gloom, it is marked by an access of impassioned expectancy which would cause the young to envy the old
claims.description: In the future society, people approach death with joyful expectancy rather than fear, due to spiritual transformation.

claims.quote: the return of the race by the fulfillment of its evolution, when the divine secret hidden in the germ shall be perfectly unfolded
claims.description: Humanity will progress over generations to a perfected evolutionary fulfillment and union with God.

claims.quote: nowhere can we find more solid ground for daring anticipations of human development during the next one thousand years
claims.description: Humanity will continue to advance onward and upward over the next thousand years toward its destiny.

claims.quote: I am a young man apparently of about thirty years of age
claims.description: A man born in 1857 sleeps over a century and awakens in the year 2000 still apparently about thirty (suspended-animation time travel).

claims.quote: It was the effort of law-givers and prophets from the earliest ages to abolish interest, or at least to limit it to the smallest possible rate.
claims.description: Interest on invested capital and the ability to live off inherited wealth will be abolished and lost as practice.
